paragraphs.text: dsh-zvec-grep
Semantic workspace search for dsh agents: hybrid BM25 + vector + RRF over a local zg index, with a s
earch-first gate on grep and rg.
**A dsh plugin that gives the model semantic workspace search: three `zg_*` tools driving the local
`zg` CLI (BM25 + vector + RRF), a search-first gate on grep/rg, and a settings card with daemon read
iness and a rebuild button. The `zg` binary and the index stay on your machine.**

##  What it does
- **Three model tools, one CLI underneath.** `zg_search` / `zg_index` / `zg_status` drive the `zg` C
LI through the host shell. Transport defaults to `--mode auto`: server when the daemon is ready, sil

ent fallback to direct otherwise - nothing starts a daemon for you.
- **A search-first gate.** In an
indexed workspace, grep/rg (shell command or native tool) is refused until a successful `zg_search`

has run; each search re-arms a quota for a time window.
- **A systemPrompt routing section** (`zvec
-grep-routing`, order 1550) plus a `tools.guard` backstop: `zg_index` requires an explicit confirm,

and every root passes one shared predicate in both guard and execute.
- **A web settings card** ("zv
ec-grep (zg)"): default embedding, limit, gate values, a daemon-readiness line, and a "rebuild works

pace" button whose jobs live in the official host job registry.
- **No index required to start.** `z
g_search` can fall back to zg's exhaustive lexical channel (the `rg` switch); a never-indexed root f
ails loudly instead of being indexed silently.
##  Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @jayyuen66/dsh-zvec-grep`. The package is on the public
npm registry; no credentials, no scoped-registry line.
- **Node.js `>= 24.9`** (ESM-only; that floor is what makes `require()` of an ESM entry work, hence

`engines.node`).
- **Host `dsh` on the `0.2.1-rc.5` or `0.2.2-alpha.3` line.** The host reads `engin
es.dsh` (`^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3`) and it **decides alone** - with that field present, compat
ibility is judged before `peerDependencies` is ever consulted, prereleases included. Any `0.2.x` at
or above `0.2.1-rc.5` passes the host gate; on the `0.2.2` prerelease line, strict npm peer resoluti

on starts at `0.2.2-alpha.3`. `0.3.0` and later need the risk grant `dsh plugin --profile

allow-
version <pkg>@<ver> --dsh-version <exact> --accept-risk`. The support window rolls: at publish time
this package is checked against every released host version inside the window - the judgement is the
host's `--dump-config` layer line for this package, while the settings card and its namespace calls
are verified once in full on the release's development baseline - and re-verified once the window m

oves, so the version number in this bullet is not a standing promise.

##  What it does not provide
- **No HTTP route of its own.** The card's data plane is the official Typert Remote namespace `zvecG
repRebuild` through the host `/api` gateway; auth, Host/DNS-rebinding/Origin checks and body limits

are all the gateway's.
- **No CLI subcommand.** `dsh zvec-grep …` does not exist.
- **The daemon lif
ecycle depends on the transport.** `transport=auto` / `cli` never start a daemon (`auto` only uses M
CP when a readiness probe says one is up); `transport=mcp` starts one with a random token (`zg --ser
ver on`, loopback 7999) and feeds that same token to every CLI child via env and to MCP calls as the
Bearer. On unload the plugin stops the daemon it started with that token. A user-started daemon (no

token by default) is only probed for readiness, never stopped.
- **No ripgrep dependency.** rg appe

ars only inside the gate predicate.
- **One file written, only for the self-started daemon.** The to
ken for `transport=mcp` is persisted at `<ZVEC_GREP_HOME or ~/.zvec-grep>/dsh-zvec-grep.token` with
mode 0600 so a restart can re-authenticate; it is removed after a successful daemon stop. Everything
else on disk is zg's business, not this package's: its index/manifest `.zvec-grep/` under the searc
hed root, its global home `~/.zvec-grep` (config, locks, models), and embedding weights fetched per

`hfEndpoint`.
- Required surfaces: `settings` / `shell` / `tools` / `systemPrompt` / `timer` (all in
`inject`). The host `jobs` service is optional - without it the rebuild paths refuse and spawn noth
ing; the three tools keep working.

##  Data and privacy
| Aspect | Content |
| Written to disk | Nothing by this package. zg owns the disk shapes: the `.zvec-grep/` index direct
ory under the searched root, its global home `~/.zvec-grep` (config/locks/models) and the embedding-

weight cache; nothing lands in the host data directory |
| What it reads | The index probe: one exis

tence check plus one manifest read |
| Network | Only the embedding-weight download driven by `hfEnd

point`, performed by zg. Remote embedding is off by default and is a deployment decision |
| Secret
exclusion | Excluded by default, case-insensitively and after your own path rules: `*.pem` / `*.key`
/ `*.p12` / `*.pfx` / `*.keystore` / `*.jks` / `*.ppk` / `id_rsa*` / `id_ed25519*` (excludeSecrets=

false to allow). Extensionless key files are not covered - declare them via ignoreFiles |
| Hidden f

iles | Skipped; ignore files honoured, unless noIgnore is set |
| Echoes | Bounded: stdout over the
cap keeps the tail; the last 400 chars of stderr are appended. Only recognised indexing progress is
dropped from stderr - degradation notices, lock conflicts and any unrecognised warning are kept; `In
dexing complete` matches on whole-line equality so the partial-failure variant is never swallowed |
| Rebuild paths | Model-side `zg_index` (rebuild=true, confirm=true) or the card button; deleting is
`zg_index` with drop=true. On unload the side table is reclaimed and running jobs are killed throug
drop=true. On unload the side table is reclaimed and running jobs are killed through the registry |
